why: {大学|だいがく}を goes with {辞|や}める, と quotes it for {言|い}い{出|だ}す, and しまつだ follows the verb.

en: If it fails, I'll simply start over from scratch.
why: {一|いち}から goes with やり{直|なお}す, and the pattern is verb + までのことだ.

en: It's best not to take medicine if you can avoid it.
why: The pattern is verb + に{越|こ}したことはない.

en: You're not a child, so think for yourself.
why: The pattern is noun + ではあるまいし, then {自分|じぶん}で goes with {考|かんが}えなさい.

before: {簡単|かんたん}な{問題|もんだい}だ
en: I thought it was an easy problem, but it was surprisingly hard and took time.
why: と{思|おも}いきや follows the quote, and {意外|いがい}に modifies {難|むずか}しくて.

before: {今年|ことし}は{結婚|けっこん}や{昇進|しょうしん}など、
en: With my wedding and promotion, this year was full of good things.
why: いいこと is the noun, ずくめ follows it, and の links to {一年|いちねん}.

en: The children were playing, covered in mud.
why: まみれ follows {泥|どろ}, and になって links to {遊|あそ}んでいた.

en: This company released the new product ahead of other companies.
why: The pattern is noun + に{先駆|さきが}けて, and {新製品|しんせいひん}を is the object of {発売|はつばい}した.

en: Lateness is not accepted, whatever the reason.
why: {理由|りゆう}の modifies いかん, then によらず, then {遅刻|ちこく}は is the topic.
